initialExam.title: TSTET 2026 (Telangana State TET)
initialExam.description: Telangana State Teacher Eligibility Test for certification of teachers for primary and upper primary levels in Telangana schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching qualification as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I: Child Development, Telugu, English/Urdu, Math, EVS. Paper II: Child Development, Languages, Subject.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper II: 150 marks, 2.5 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: TSTET Qualification → DSC Recruitment by Telangana
initialExam.jobRole: SGT and School Assistant in Telangana schools
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit tstet.cgg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
